whitelist.title: Edit whitelist
whitelist.description: One IP or CIDR network per line.

ban.title: Ban IPs
ban.description:
Just type the IP address, one per line: **date and time are added automatically**.

Example:
```
45.12.33.7
103.55.1.9
```
Choose the duration: **Permanent** or timed (the IP is unbanned automatically when it expires).

IPs are written to ip_bans.yaml and blocked immediately, no restart. Single IPs only, no networks.

Optional: for a different date, write it after the IP, e.g. `45.12.33.7 21/11/2026 01:42`.

unban.title: Unban IPs
unban.description: Select the IPs to remove from ip_bans.yaml.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description:
**Telegram**: on every failed login you get a message with Ban / Ban 24h / Whitelist / Ignore buttons. Requires the Telegram Bot integration. Leave Chat ID empty to use the default one.

**Country and provider**: for external IPs, country and provider are looked up on the free ip-api.com service (the IP is sent to that service).

import_file.description: Read a backup file from the /config folder and add missing banned IPs and whitelist networks. Nothing is removed.
